units.title: The Wright Brothers
units.blurb: From kites and gliders at Kitty Hawk to a wind tunnel in Dayton and the first powered flights.

topics.title: The Wright Brothers: Gliders and the Wind Tunnel
topics.short: Wilbur (1867–1912) and Orville (1871–1948) Wright solved control first with wing-warping, then found the tables of lift were wrong and built a wind tunnel in 1901.
topics.trouble: People think the Wrights' big idea was the engine; their key ideas were control in three directions and better wing data.

topics.title: The Wright Brothers: The 1903 Flyer and After
topics.short: With their own engine and propellers, the Wrights flew four times on December 17, 1903, then spent years learning to fly in circles and for long times.
topics.trouble: People think the first flight was long and high; it lasted 12 seconds and covered 120 feet.
